Name: Jellyfish in Shipping Bin
Author: Miihau
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Introducing the enchanting "[color=#00ffff]Jellyfish in shipping Bin[/color]" mod for Stardew Valley!
[img]https://iili.io/H4oWxOQ.gif[/img]﻿[/b][/size]
[size=5]Prepare for a delightful surprise every time you place an item in the shipping bin. Watch as a playful jellyfish pops out for a brief moment, adding a touch of whimsy to your daily routine. This visual effect brings a smile to your face as you witness the jellyfish's graceful appearance. Experience the joy of farming alongside this aquatic companion, making your shipping routine an enchanting experience. Let the Jellyfish in shipping Bin mod illuminate your path to a world filled with laughter and wonder in Pelican Town.
[/size][/center]

Downloads.Description: This is actually a troll mod for NinoKito
